usage.costBasis: CLI-reported list-price estimate (total_cost_usd), cumulative per session; not provider-billed
usage.finalMessage:
I added `estimate <copy>`, which uses the current fine schedule from DEC-010 (0.20 a day, capped at 5.00), records nothing, and appears in `help` right after `renew <copy>`; `dotnet test Lending.slnx` passes 20 of 20.
Returns still charge the old DEC-003 rates (0.25 a day, cap 10.00) because L14 says existing behaviour must not change, so an estimate can be lower than the fine actually charged on return.
I recorded that, and whether DEC-010 applies to dates before 2026-03-01, as open questions for Finance in `.work/report.json`, which is committed with the work.
OUTCOME: completed
